g.text: Plans, approves, reviews, and owns outcomes
Claims work, reads context, implements, and reports outcomes
Invokes arm commands and lifecycle hooks
Replicates code branches and the orphan _armature ops branch
Protects main and provides PR/MR governance
Authoritative source documents fetched only by source lifecycle commands
People and external systems are outside Armature
Components are deploy-time parts of the single arm binary
Cylinders are Git-backed or local filesystem data stores
Solid arrows show runtime calls or data movement
Scriptable CLI commands, human TUI flows, stable output formats, and exit codes
claim, ready, context, decompose, worker, worktree
Builds the DAG workflow, computes ready work, manages claims, assembles task context, and provisions worktrees
Defines typed operations and appends each worker's facts to its exclusive JSONL log
Validates and replays operations into deterministic current issue, graph, queue, and checkpoint views
Enforces delivery provenance, scope, repository health, citation coverage, and deterministic completion checks
Prepares review bundles, validates assessments, and records advisory attestations; never decides merges
Registers, caches, fingerprints, verifies, and connects requirement sources to issue provenance
Isolates Git, shell, filesystem, HTTP, configuration, installation, and hook concerns
Ships planner, coordinator, worker, reviewer, auditor, and activity-indexer instructions
Product code and per-issue managed worktrees
Git-tracked append-only source of coordination truth; one log per worker
Git-tracked provider-normalized documents, manifest, and fingerprints
Local-only derived indexes, ready queues, issues, traceability, and checkpoints
